COMBINED PLAN POSITION 11 (epoch:planned-combined-plan-reflow2-and-flo2, agreed 2026-09-27; it was 10 of 10 until two flo2.io increments were added the same night). After positions 9 and 10.

Step 8, the last of the tracked-export retirement plan (2026-09-27). flo2's design moves to a server first, then reflow2's (the order set by dec:idea-a-repo-that-holds-its-design-moves-it-to-a-remote-server-once), each by import, each repo's folder then naming its design (step 3). Then the machinery kept "in service, not in purpose" by chg:sharing-a-design-through-git-is-retired-2026-09-27 retires: req:stale-seat-knows, dec:export-once-per-pr, req:the-saved-design-merges-correctly-under-gits-ordinary-merge, the file lineage of dec:export-hash-chain, req:the-server-keeps-the-working-tree-export-current (made optional), and the committed-export gate. Delivers req:a-photocopy-says-it-is-one. The hub then watches reflow2 and flo2 by address too. Needs steps 6 and 7.

2026-09-28 — FLO2'S HALF HAPPENED AHEAD OF THIS POSITION, on Anthony's word ("move flo2 now, don't wait for the release", after "yes, do the flo2 move next … share the flo2 design with my brother"). flo2's design is on flo2.io as 1a97fc1f1de4d5d2 (id kept, 1094 nodes at the move), owned by who:ajs with Alex a member (who:alex); settled in flo2's design as dec:flo2s-own-design-moves-onto-flo2-io-before-v0730-2026-09-28. It moved BEFORE positions 9 and 10 and before v0.73.0 was published, so it runs on a named stopgap: each flo2 PR commits a copy of the hosted design refreshed by flo2's ops/flo2-design-copy (flo2 #92, 8bdb974), which the design gate reads. The local store was moved aside, not deleted. What stays at this position: reflow2's own move, retiring the tracked-export machinery, req:a-photocopy-says-it-is-one, and ending flo2's copy stopgap once position 9 lets CI check against the hosted design.
